name: NGC 4051
notes: XMM-Newton RGS1/RGS2 pipeline products for obsid 0109141401 (117 ks). The counts spectra (SRSPEC, ~25 kB) are committed; the response matrices (RSPMAT1003/2003, 30/12 MB) are NOT, because they are large. Fetch them from XSA with: https://nxsa.esac.esa.int/nxsa-sl/servlet/data-action-aio?obsno=0109141401&level=PPS&instname=R1&name=RSP (same for R2), then place RSPMAT*.FTZ next to the SRSPEC files. The tool pairs each spectrum with the response of the same spectral order.
